style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines and plain wooden artist's mannequins (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: real dead bodies, corpses, blood, wounds, faces resembling real people, police or agency badges, logos, readable text or numbers
